performance_engine: NautilusTrader 1.230.0 only via existing candidate-02 run_window architecture

failure_diagnosis.v75: requiring the opening shock to have already broken the immediately prior 15-minute boundary selected only one or two overextended events per mode and every executed event lost
failure_diagnosis.event_funnel: 43 strong opening shocks existed; 10 had aligned remaining-50-second flow and front-side depth withdrawal; their directional completed-close return remained positive across 30-240 minutes
failure_diagnosis.controlled_change: remove the already-broken-boundary requirement and trade the continuing child-order wave only when the rest of the opening minute remains aligned and front-side depth is withdrawn

market_logic.state: a synchronized quarter-hour aggressive opening shock with continuing rest-of-minute flow and withdrawal of liquidity in front of the shock
market_logic.scenario: the shock is a continuing execution wave, not a terminal sweep; the previous accepted close range measures the auction scale
market_logic.confirmation: the containing opening minute completes with price and flow still aligned
market_logic.invalidation: one previous accepted close-range adverse traversal from entry
market_logic.target: one or 1.25 previous accepted close-range continuation from entry

fixed_risk.quantity_rule: current NautilusTrader account NAV times 3% divided by expected per-unit loss including entry and stop fees, slippage, impact and funding

promotion_rule: Only a variant satisfying every gate can be frozen unchanged before a new second BTC week is selected. No result from this revealed development week is a holdout result.
